name: Pixel Buddy
tagline: A free companion for a kinder workday, on the desktop and in Chrome. It sits near the corner of your screen, leads you through short breaks and helps you remember your water.

updates.title: Pixel Buddy 1.4: break streaks and quiet during any call
updates.body: Pixel Buddy started keeping a weekly history and counting break streaks. On macOS it notices a call in any app that is using the microphone, without ever opening the microphone itself, and holds reminders until the call ends. The Chrome extension gained an on/off switch and live timers in its settings.

updates.title: Pixel Buddy 1.3: break notes
updates.body: When a break is due you can jot down what you were doing, and the buddy shows it when you are back. Recent notes can be exported as a text file. This release also fixed Open at Login.

updates.title: Pixel Buddy 1.2: quiet during calls and buddy moods
updates.body: Break and water reminders started waiting until a call ends, and sitting still on a call no longer counts as being away. You can choose how long without input counts as away, the buddy gained moods, and a battery drain was fixed.
